description:
daraja4j - a dependency-free Java SDK for the Safaricom Daraja M-Pesa API:
    OAuth access tokens, STK Push, C2B, B2C, B2B, B2Pochi, transaction reversal,
    transaction status, account balance, the Pull API, and M-Pesa Ratiba standing
    orders. Compatible with Java 8 through the latest LTS, and every major Java
    web framework.
